links.outcome: Classification AUC overall versus among high-confidence predictions from the SToPS confidence estimates
links.effect: AUC 0.789 overall, rising to 0.904 on samples with confidence ≥ 0.95.
links.quote: DepressLLM provides interpretable depression predictions and, via its Score-guided Token Probability Summation (SToPS) module, delivers both improved classification performance and reliable confidence estimates, achieving an AUC of 0.789, which rises to 0.904 on samples with confidence $\geq$ 0.95.

unlisted_practices: Interpretable domain-adapted LLM with score-guided token probability summation for confidence estimation in depression detection

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates DepressLLM, an LLM-based tool for depression detection from narratives, evaluating it across multiple datasets and including error analysis (psychiatric review of misclassifications), but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
